description: Governor's Office - Western Province -- The Order made See. 185 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act. No. 15 of 1987 read with See. 2 of Provincial Councial (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989
reasoning: This gazette content involves the appointment of a retired judge to conduct an inquiry into alleged misconduct by a local government official (Chairman of Divulapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) and includes the suspension of the official. It deals with judicial/law enforcement matters including investigation procedures, evidence collection, and temporary suspension of a public official pending inquiry, which falls under Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes).
